scripts.format: bunx prettier . --write --ignore-path .prettierignore; cd api; uvx ruff check --fix; uvx ruff format
scripts.typecheck: cd cli; bun run typecheck; bun run lint; cd ../api; uvx ty check
scripts.db:db-diff: bun run db:start; bunx supabase db diff --local -f latest
scripts.api:codegen: bunx supabase gen types --lang python --local --schema public,storage > api/src/persistence/schema/generated.py
scripts.dev: sh -c 'export UID=$(id -u) GID=$(id -g); bun run db:start; (docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml ps -a --quiet | grep . >/dev/null || bun run dev:build); docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml up --watch'
scripts.dev:build: sh -c 'export UID=$(id -u) GID=$(id -g); docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml build'
scripts.dev:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down; bun run db:stop
scripts.dev:clean: rm -rf node_modules; cd cli; rm -rf node_modules; cd ../api; rm -rf .venv; cd ../supabase; rm -rf .branches; rm -rf .temp
scripts.dev:install: bun install; cd cli; bun install; cd ../api; uv sync
scripts.dev:update: bun update --latest; cd cli; bun update --latest; cd ../api; uv sync --upgrade
